title: centaurea tenuifolia f. pinae
intro: Centaurea tenuifolia f. pinae, commonly known as Japanese aster or Yellow Flower Centaury, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving menstrual cramps and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea tenuifolia f. pinae include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
